title: Exact sparse spectrum learner
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, use the positive exact sparse spectrum learner when $n>0$, and use the zero-dimensional exact sparse spectrum learner when $n=0$. The resulting program is a deterministic query program on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube with output a sparse Fourier hypothesis in dimension $n$.
caveat: The positive-dimensional and zero-dimensional learner constructions are referenced but not defined in the supplied material.
